concern_summary: This concern deals with message threads, focusing on the display and interaction management of messages, including the identification of parent and child messages within those threads.

This concern pertains to the management of transaction threads, encompassing the creation, checking, updating, and deletion of transaction-related reports and ensuring the system maintains accurate visibility and state management of these threads.
This concern captures functionalities related to expense modification messages, including the construction and processing of original messages and modified expense reports.
This concern addresses functionalities related to chat messages, including tracking unread markers and managing the visibility of messages in chat interactions.
This concern captures functionalities that manage reporting messages related to status updates on pending requests and actions taken.
This concern focuses on handling messages associated with monetary transactions, specifically during wallet transfers and updating IOU reports.

This concern involves functionalities that deal with user messages regarding money requests and transaction details, focusing on permission checks and the construction of transaction representations in the context of Input Output User and Unit Messages.
This concern emphasizes the management of message content, ensuring the uniqueness and validation of message strings used in various contexts.
This concern aggregates functionalities related to displaying and managing messages pertaining to bank accounts, including error messages and connection instructions.
This concern encapsulates the functionality that enables the application to operate in offline mode, managing the network behavior accordingly.
